Step-by-Step Guide

Tap any step timer to launch Cook Mode right there

restaurant_menu
1

Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out 1 cup thai sweet glutinous rice and 1 cup full-fat coconut milk + 3 tbsp sugar so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

2

Steam Sweet Rice Tender

Rinse and steam 1 cup thai sweet glutinous rice for 18 minutes until translucent and chewy. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure 1 cup thai sweet glutinous rice are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.

3

Fold Warm Salted Coconut Cream

Pour warm 1 cup full-fat coconut milk + 3 tbsp sugar with a pinch of sea salt over hot rice, cover 10 mins to absorb, and plate with 2 mangoes ripe golden mangoes (sliced) and extra salted coconut cream.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

A generous pinch of sea salt in the coconut topping makes the mango taste twice as sweet.

4

Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve

Transfer Thai Coconut Mango Sticky Rice Parfait to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 4 portions.

Nutrition, Storage & Healthy Prep Notes

CALORIES310 kcal
SERVINGS4
SUGAR MODEClassic

Make-Ahead & Storage: Keep thai coconut mango sticky rice parfait in an airtight glass container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days (or freeze individual portions up to 1 month). Pair with unsweetened Greek yogurt, fresh berries, or espresso for a balanced treat.

Keto & Low-Sugar Tip: Toggle Healthy Swap above to substitute refined sugar with monk fruit or coconut sugar and white flour with oat or almond flour.
